analysis.one_line_summary: Static Black Friday receipt graphic advertising the Wavytalk Sleek & Bounce Duo bundle for $133.00 (33% off).
analysis.full_description: A static graphic designed to resemble a wrinkled printed store receipt set over a deep burgundy background. At the top of the receipt, the Wavytalk logo and 'Black Friday' are displayed, followed by the price deal '$133.00 | 33% OFF' and a pill callout stating 'You save: $65.00'. Below, receipt lines itemize 'SLEEK & BOUNCE DUO' with 'Steambrush Pro 2.0 + Blowout Boost'. Studio product cutouts of the pink Steambrush Pro 2.0 and the pink Blowout Boost round thermal brush appear side by side. A dark plum circular badge on the right highlights 'TODAY ONLY', with barcode accents on the edges.
